title: VanillaFlow
description: Performance-first vanilla+ Fabric modpack with extended render distance, quality-of-life mods, and an exclusive custom data pack that makes exploration and farming feel rewarding.
body:
# ✨ VanillaFlow — Performance Meets Polish

**VanillaFlow** is a lightweight Fabric modpack for Minecraft 26.1.2 built around one idea: 
Minecraft, but *better*. No overhauls. No magic systems. No tech trees. 
Just the vanilla experience you love — smoother, smarter, and more alive.

---

## ⚡ Performance First

Under the hood, VanillaFlow runs a best-in-class optimization stack so you 
spend less time stuttering and more time playing — whether you're on a 
flagship PC or a budget laptop.

- **Sodium** — Rewrites the rendering engine for up to 5x better FPS
- **Lithium** — Smarter mob AI, chunk loading, and game logic
- **FerriteCore** — Cuts RAM usage by up to 50%
- **Krypton** — Optimized networking for smoother multiplayer
- **ModernFix** — Faster startup times and better memory management
- **Iris Shaders** — Optional shader support, fully Sodium-compatible
- **Voxy** — Extended render distance using Level of Detail rendering (see much further with minimal performance cost)

---

## 🌿 Vanilla+ Quality of Life

Every mod in this pack feels like it *should've* been in the base game.

- **Jade** — Hover over any block or entity to see what it is
- **AppleSkin** — See your hunger and saturation at a glance
- **Xaero's Minimap + World Map** — Lightweight, vanilla-styled map
- **Xaero's Maps X Waystones** — Seamless integration between your map and fast travel
- **Waystones** — Craftable fast-travel points that fit right into survival
- **Graves** — Keep your items safe with grave markers on death
- **Dynamic Lights** — Held torches actually light up the world
- **Zoomify** — Smooth, configurable zoom key

---

## 🌍 World Generation

- **Geophilic** — Subtle enhancements to vanilla biomes using only vanilla blocks
- **Tectonic** — Advanced terrain generation for more varied and interesting landscapes

---

## 📦 Data Packs Included

### ✨ **VanillaFlow Signature Pack** (What Makes Us Unique)

Our custom data pack, built exclusively for this modpack to give it a distinctive feel:

**🪙 Enhanced Mob Drops**
- 5% chance mobs drop 1-2 diamonds
- 3% chance for emeralds (great for trading)
- 8% chance for amethyst shards
- Rare drops feel rewarding without breaking progression

**🌾 Better Farming & Crop Yields**
- Wheat: +15% extra seed drop
- Carrots: +10% bonus yield
- Potatoes: +10% bonus yield
- Beetroot: +12% extra seed drop
- Farming feels less grindy without being overpowered

**Why This Matters:**
Most vanilla+ packs are generic performance + QoL mods. VanillaFlow goes further with a custom data pack that makes exploration, farming, and mob hunting feel *rewarding*. This is what sets us apart.

### Standard Quality-of-Life Packs
- **Vanilla Tweaks** — Curated tweaks including mob heads, custom structures, and more
- **Enhanced Mechanics** — Carefully selected tweaks to improve survival gameplay without changing vanilla feel

---

## 📋 View All Data Pack Tweaks

[**→ Open Interactive Tweaks List ←**](https://benoodle7.github.io/vanillaflow-modpack/)

Browse all 24 data pack tweaks in a beautiful, interactive Minecraft-themed interface! Click the link to explore what's included.

---

## 🖥️ Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition **26.1.2**
- Fabric Loader **latest**
- Java **25+**
- Minimum **4GB RAM** allocated (6GB recommended)
- OpenGL 4.6 support (for Voxy)

---

## 💬 Support & Updates

Found an issue or have a suggestion? Report it here:

**On Modrinth** — Use the issue tracker on this modpack's page (easiest if you're already here)

**On GitHub** — [Open an issue](https://github.com/benoodle7/vanillaflow-modpack/issues) for detailed bug reports

**When reporting, please include:**

- What went wrong
- What you expected to happen
- Your system specs & Java version

VanillaFlow is updated regularly to stay current with Minecraft releases.

---

## 🎮 Why Choose VanillaFlow?

✅ **Fastest performance** — Best-in-class optimization stack
✅ **Truly vanilla** — Every addition fits seamlessly
✅ **Extended render distance** — Voxy lets you see further without lag
✅ **Unique signature** — Custom data pack no other pack has
✅ **Actively maintained** — Regular updates & community support
✅ **Beginner-friendly** — Works on budget hardware
